question: Which of the following viruses has its genetic material segmented in the virion?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Coronavirus -> single-stranded RNA genome -> non-segmented -> 10% CHAIN: Rhabdovirus -> negative-sense single-stranded RNA genome -> segmented -> 80% CHAIN: Orthomyxovirus -> negative-sense single-stranded RNA genome -> segmented -> 90% CHAIN: Filovirus -> negative-sense single-stranded RNA genome -> non-segmented -> 10%
analysis: Orthomyxovirus is the virus that has its genetic material segmented in the virion.
